# Chetan Bhosale

> Chetan Bhosale is a founding engineer at Linkrunner (mobile attribution) and a backend engineer at Respan (YC W24, AI gateway and evals), based in Bengaluru, India. He started in sales and marketing, moved into engineering, and now ships products end to end: customer calls, design, React and React Native front ends, Go and Node.js services, Kafka, ClickHouse and Kubernetes.

Key facts:

- Current: Founding Engineer at Linkrunner (Oct 2025 to present) and Backend Engineer at Respan (YC W24)
- Before: Software Engineer at Petpooja via TransErg (Jun 2024 to Sep 2025); Sales, then Full-stack Engineer at Hire My Assistants (Dec 2022 to Jun 2023)
- Highlights: rebuilt the Linkrunner dashboard and migrated every account in 20 days; moved analytics from Postgres to ClickHouse (seconds to milliseconds, up to $8K a month saved); Go microservices serving 25M+ requests a month; SDKs on five platforms; 3M+ food images delivered to Zomato and Swiggy at Petpooja
- Stack: TypeScript, Go, Python, React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, Kafka, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP
- Education: BCA, St. Xavier's College, Ahmedabad (2021 to 2024)
- Also: three national karate golds; makes music, draws, games and cooks

## Projects

- [Nakama](https://trynakama.com): clone production stacks into safe sandboxes with masked data, for AI agents and testing

- [geo.repair](https://geo.repair): AI crawler audit that applies fixes and opens the PR
